test_case.test_name: Variant-bound physical, BIOS, Windows and Linux CPU vendor/socket identity validation
test_case.purpose: Using the exact row/variant, prove approved CPUs occupy intended sockets and vendor/model/family/architecture/core-thread topology agree across physical records, BIOS, Windows, Linux and SMBIOS.
required_package: Approved CPU/socket/core-thread matrix and installation record
BIOS screenshots and qualified Windows/Linux targets
util-linux, dmidecode and owner-approved Windows inventory command
String normalization/error rules and preserved logs
test_case.test_command: Select only `Functionality|2194|Wistron-HW-00475-V002` / `11b4af82c27ba7f5`. Correlate operator CPU/socket installation and BIOS screenshots with full native Windows CPU/socket inventory and authenticated Linux `lscpu` plus untruncated `sudo dmidecode -t 4` stdout/stderr. Compare every socket, vendor/model/family, architecture, core and thread field to the signed matrix.
test_case.expected_result: Every intended socket contains the approved CPU and physical, BIOS, Windows, Linux and SMBIOS identities/topology agree with the signed normalization rules; no unexplained hardware/error-log delta appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when all required surfaces and every populated socket match. Wrong/missing CPU/socket, topology or unexplained cross-surface mismatch is FAIL. Missing runtime CPU matrix, target or required evidence is BLOCKED; duplicate code alone does not prevent composite-key execution.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until composite identity, CPU/socket matrix, verified OS targets, authorization and evidence methods are signed.
Operator owns CPU installation and BIOS observation; agent performs read-only OS collection only.
No hardware/BIOS change, secret-bearing command, log clear, truncation, stderr suppression or retry.
Stop on target/OS/variant mismatch, privilege failure or identity/topology discrepancy.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant/hash and explicit exclusion of row 2273 MLPerf
CPU PN/serial-to-socket installation record and signed expected matrix
Full timestamped Windows inventory with OS/command identity
Full Linux lscpu and untruncated SMBIOS Type 4 stdout/stderr
Preserved logs, normalization/discrepancy analysis and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Read-only collection changes no DUT state. Stop on target, privilege or identity mismatch, preserve raw output and escalate; do not install/remove CPU, alter BIOS, clear logs or retry against another target.
